answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens in a shared haven, a contract that holds it for ten epochs before the agent's votes count. A farm of 1,000 fakes therefore ties up 500,000 tokens and earns nothing until the lock ends. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because every identity still needs its own full bond, and peers flag accounts whose bonds trace to one source. The ledger shows bonded accounts in ivory and unproven ones in umber. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back in full when it leaves.
